entries.name: Rabatteur de fret
entries.reason: Brief IDs superseded during concurrent specification; preserved as independent concept candidates.
entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one isolated full-body enemy base sprite for a grounded 2D side-view fighting game, portrait 1024x1536. Original fan-made character for a Death Stranding-inspired coastal logistics extension, NOT an official canonical character. High-end realistic painted game asset, realistic human anatomy, weathered practical industrial expedition fabric/polymer/metal, restrained cold desaturated palette, fine sharp readable silhouette. Adult human, full body in a neutral ready stance facing RIGHT, side-view with torso only slightly turned toward camera, boots on same imaginary horizontal ground line, no perspective foreshortening. Entire head, hands, gear and boots inside canvas with clear margins. One subject ONLY. Actual transparent alpha background, no floor, no scenery, no shadow plane, no backdrop, no grey haze around silhouette. No labels, no logos, no watermark, no BB pod, no skull mask, no superhero armor, no fantasy ornaments. Handheld equipment remains intact, no flying projectile or detached gear in this image.
Asset name: Rabatteur de fret.
Detailed subject brief (French): Un seul humain adulte ennemi, tenue de porteur ocre usée, demi-masque respiratoire banal, sac cargo court, gants épais, une perche courte non tranchante tenue basse. Silhouette mince penchée en avant, profil combat 2D, fond transparent, corps entier.
